annotations.title: Run a local pack rank check

description: Runs a local pack rank check now — one live scrape of Google's public local search results (not the paid Places API). Returns "found" with a real 1-based position, "not_found" (parsed cleanly, business absent), or "unavailable" (scraper disabled, blocked, or unparsable) — never a fabricated position. Fails with SEO_DATA_UNAVAILABLE where the deployment has not enabled the scraper. Tightly rate limited, so do not loop it.

configId.description: Config ID, from the matching get_* tool called without configId.

projectId.description: Required. The MisarSEO project ID to scope this call to. Get one from list_projects.

name: run_local_pack_rank_check
